findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: the handoff file no longer exists - the whole app/apis/debug package was removed rather than guarded, which eliminates the unconstrained-serialization surface outright. Corroborated by apis/router.py:6 and apis/admin/services/get_internal_status_service.py:3 (both describe /debug as replaced), and by tests/security/test_endpoint_authorization.py:189-218 which assert /debug returns 404 and that the package and its imports are gone. Repository-wide check of every @router decorator shows an explicit response_model= on every path operation that returns a body; the single exception, DELETE /menu/{item_id}, is 204 No Content and serializes nothing. Output schemas are minimized (apis/auth/schemas.py UserRead exposes username, phone_number, names and role only - no hashed_password, token or admin flag), and register_user_service adds response_model_exclude_unset. No handler returns a bare ORM instance or dict without a declared schema. | verdict=pass confidence=high
